name: Ayurveda Consultation & Care
shortDescription: Root-cause diagnostic assessment examining Prakriti, Vikriti, lifestyle, and individual pulse evaluation.
description: A 45-minute comprehensive consultation with our senior physicians. Includes Prakriti (body constitution) analysis, pulse diagnosis (Nadi Pariksha), dietary counseling, and personalized prescription planning.

name: Panchakarma Detox & Rejuvenation
shortDescription: Traditional 5-fold purification therapeutic programs administered under physician oversight.
description: Structured therapeutic detoxification designed to eliminate bio-accumulated toxins (Ama), restore metabolic Agni, and revitalize tissue immunity through authentic traditional procedures.

name: Traditional Ayurvedic Therapies
shortDescription: Abhyanga, Kizhi, Shirodhara, and specialized localized Basti treatments for joint and nerve relief.
description: Targeted external therapies utilizing medicated herbal oils, warm herbal poultices (Kizhi), continuous forehead oil pouring (Shirodhara), and specialized joint reservoirs.

name: Wellness, AHARA & Therapeutic Yoga
shortDescription: Integrating customized South Indian nutrition, daily routine (Dinacharya), and therapeutic movement.
description: Holistic lifestyle integration matching your biological rhythm. Includes personalized AHARA meal maps, seasonal routines (Ritucharya), and therapeutic yoga postures.
